en.accountCredentialMalformed: The saved sign-in credentials are malformed, so account status cannot be read. Retrying will not delete saved sign-in information.
en.accountCredentialUnavailable: The saved sign-in credentials are temporarily unavailable. Retry; saved sign-in information will not be deleted.
en.accountStatusTimeout: Reading account status timed out. Retry.
en.accountStatusTransport: The account service is unavailable. Check the connection and retry.
en.accountStatusUnknown: Could not read account status. Retry.
en.autoQuotaRetryHint: Opt in to wait for confirmed short quota resets. The turn shows why it is waiting and can be stopped; switching accounts retries immediately.
en.catalogFailed: Could not read the account model catalog. Check the network and try again.
en.catalogSignedOut: Sign in to show the models your account can use.
en.compactionHint: Experimental, off by default. Codex compacts long requests while DSH history and native compaction remain available. These requests use SSE; changed history invalidates previous checkpoints.
en.connectionHint: SSE by default. Experimental WebSocket reuses connections and context transfers and can fall back to SSE on connection failure. Applies to the next request; context limits stay the same.
en.contextCustomHint: Enter the full token count; lower values make official agent presets compact sooner.
en.contextExtendedHint: Uses each model's audited extended budget (Astra: 872K); availability depends on the service.
en.contextStandardHint: Use the model catalog default; official agent presets manage context automatically.
en.creditsAfterAllowance: Credits are only drawn once the plan allowance runs out; there is no official switch to spend them first.
en.creditsExpiryEstimate: (Estimate: the published expiry of the Pro 200 compensation Credits; the API does not report it, so check ChatGPT usage settings)
en.creditsNote: Extra Credits, spending caps, and resets are separate items.
en.defaultModelFailed: Reading or saving the default model failed. Retry, or switch the model inside a chat.
en.defaultModelFollowHint: Following the DSH default: {value}. Pick a Codex model to make every new conversation start with it.
en.defaultModelHint: The model a new conversation opens with. This writes the same DSH default model setting as switching the model inside a chat.
en.defaultModelNoCatalog: Sign in and load models to choose a default model.
en.defaultModelUnavailable: This DSH version provides no default-model service, so it cannot be set here.
en.deviceHint: Enter this device code on the sign-in page:
en.diagnosticFinding_catalog-gap: The online catalog contains capabilities not supported by this adapter. This does not mean the model is unavailable.
en.diagnosticFinding_collection-incomplete: Some checks could not finish. Inspect failed or timed-out collectors in the details.
en.diagnosticFinding_evidence-truncated: Older records or additional host scopes are omitted. This snapshot does not cover the entire history.
en.diagnosticFinding_recent-failure: An operation or request failed within 15 minutes without a later success for the same operation. Inspect its timestamp and details.
en.diagnosticFinding_version-mismatch: Client and server versions differ. Restart DSH and regenerate the report.
en.diagnosticNext_regenerate: Regenerate immediately after reproducing. If collection remains incomplete, include the steps with your report.
en.diagnosticNext_reproduce: Match the operations and timestamps below to your problem. If failures persist, provide reproduction steps and this report.
en.diagnosticNext_restart: Restart and regenerate. If versions still differ, check that the plugin update took effect.
en.diagnosticNext_supported-options: Keep using supported choices. New capabilities need adapter validation; do not insert unknown parameters manually.
en.diagnosticsCopyFailed: Copy failed. Expand the details to copy manually.
en.diagnosticsCoverageHint: Shows prerequisites and process-wide evidence from the last 15 minutes, not limited to this account or session. RPC, network and tool outcomes are not end-to-end validation.
en.diagnosticsFailed: Server diagnostics unavailable. A local, redacted report is available to copy. Check the DSH service and plugin version.
en.diagnosticsHint: Generate a report to copy into a support request. Sign-in credentials and account identifiers are excluded.
en.diagnosticsHostCollected: Host registrations and selection are included. Registrant labels may be minified; they do not identify packages or prove interference.
en.diagnosticsHostUnknown: Host inspection unavailable or unmounted; interference cannot be determined.
en.diagnosticsNoRecordedFailure: No failure in the current records; unused features remain unverified.
en.diagnosticsPartial: Some inspections failed or timed out. Other results are preserved; see details.
en.diagnosticsUnresolved: Other failures remain without a later success; see the summary.
en.diagnosticsVersionMismatch: Client and server versions differ. Reload and retry.
en.effortsEmpty: This model provides no reasoning effort levels.
en.forecastResolution: Not enough change to estimate the rate yet
en.forecastStale: Quota data is stale; waiting for an update
en.imageAnnotateHint: Click the image to add a numbered note
en.imageAnnotationPlaceholder: Describe what should change in this area
en.imageBrowsingHint: Preview pasted and conversation images, annotate and return to the composer.
en.imageCapabilityHint: Let the model create or edit images when you ask.
en.imageCreatePrompt: Use the subscription image tool for the following request. If reference images are attached, edit those images:
en.imageDraftFailed: Could not update the draft. Keep your brief and check whether the composer is busy or contains references.
en.imageDraftHint: Add to your draft, then send when ready. Attach references in the composer. Nothing is generated or existing text replaced automatically.
en.imageDropUnavailable: Images cannot be added right now
en.imageEditFailed: Handoff failed. Add a note to every marker and ensure the composer accepts images, then retry.
en.imageEditReferenceGuide: The clean source for this edit is "{sourceName}"; "{referenceName}" is the numbered location reference. Coordinates start at the top-left, x increases rightward and y downward; percentages refer to the whole image. Inspect both images and pass both as references to the image-editing tool. Preserve every number, position and requested change below in the tool prompt. Edit the corresponding content in the clean source; numbers, dots and leader lines on the location reference are guidance only and must not appear in the final result. If either image cannot be read or a location is unclear, explain the problem instead of guessing or ignoring annotations.
en.imageEntryPointsHint: @Image shortcut. Natural-language image requests still work when hidden.
en.imageLoadFailed: Image failed to load. Click to retry
en.imageModelHint: Image 2.5 options are experimental: requests generated images successfully, but the requested model and quality are not confirmed.
en.imageSettingsHint: Disabling features preserves existing images. Sketches need reference editing; annotations need the enhanced viewer.
en.imageZoomHint: Wheel to zoom · drag to pan · double-click for 100%
en.inputImageDetailHint: Controls the detail level of images sent to the model. Higher detail uses more input tokens.
en.manualCode: If the browser callback did not finish automatically, paste the code or full redirect URL.
en.modelDirectoryFailed: Could not load the model directory. Try again.
en.modelMenuAria: Model, effort, speed, and output detail
en.modelsEmpty: No models available. Sign in and make sure the network is reachable.
en.modelsHidden: All models are hidden from this list. Show one in settings.
en.noUsage: Sign in to read quota windows reported by ChatGPT.
en.pickerModelsHint: Only controls the composer model list. Selected models and requests still work. New models appear by default.
en.quickQuotaForecastCalibratingStatus: Codex quota: {value}% remaining; runway is calibrating
en.quickQuotaForecastHint: Estimates recent two-hour consumption; recalibrates with insufficient data or changing pace. Details show a range. Indicative only; history stays local.
en.quickQuotaForecastIdleStatus: Codex quota: {value}% remaining; no measurable consumption pace
en.quickQuotaForecastStatus: Codex quota: {value}% remaining; about {duration} at the current pace
en.quickQuotaForecastUntilResetStatus: Codex quota: {value}% remaining; enough until reset at the current pace
en.quotaAlertsHint: Warn at the selected remaining threshold. Custom sets short and long windows separately. Fresh data only; no interrupting popups.
en.quotaForecastUntilReset: Enough until reset at current pace
en.quotaIndicatorHint: Show an icon in the composer; click for details. Hiding it pauses forecast sampling.
en.quotaSeparateWindows: Each window is independent. Exhausting either window can limit usage.
en.quotaWarning: {window}: {value}% remaining. Check usage and reset time.
en.recoveryClearConfirm: Confirm clear and sign in again
en.recoveryClearHint: Removes all subscription sign-ins saved by this plugin. Conversations and settings remain. You can then sign in again.
en.recoveryFailed: Clearing was not confirmed. Restore the DSH service before retrying.
en.recoveryHint: If retry fails, clear sign-in data. Restore the DSH service first if disconnected. Local diagnostics are available under Advanced.
en.resetAccountChanged: The signed-in account changed. Start again.
en.resetAcknowledge: I understand this may consume one reset now
en.resetAcknowledgeRequired: Confirm that you understand this may consume a reset.
en.resetAlready: This reset request was already processed.
en.resetEarlyWarning: Quota remains. The service may decline the reset.
en.resetFailed: Could not use the quota reset.
en.resetInProgress: A quota reset is already in progress.
en.resetNothing: There is currently nothing to reset; no new reset was consumed.
en.resetRenewLogin: Your sign-in expired. Sign in again.
en.resetTooEarly: Wait for the cooldown before confirming.
en.resetUncertain: The server result is uncertain. Confirm again to check the same request; the plugin will not start a separate reset.
en.resetWarning: This consumes one reset and cannot be undone.
en.runtimeActive: Codex subtasks are running. Wait for them to finish before installing or uninstalling.
en.runtimeBuildBlocked: DSH blocked dependency build scripts. Review them in the official plugin manager before installing.
en.runtimeCancelled: Installation cancelled. You can try again.
en.runtimeConfirm: Uninstalling switches subtasks back to DSH. Subscription chat, images, sign-in and sketches stay available. Uninstall this optional component?
en.runtimeFailed: The operation did not complete. Refresh and retry; see DSH plugin management for details.
en.runtimeHostUnsupported: No Codex subtask component has been verified for this DSH version.
en.runtimeIncompatible: An incompatible Codex subtask component was found. Uninstall it, restart DSH, then install the supported version.
en.runtimeInstallHint: DSH installs and removes the official Codex subtask component here. Installation does not enable subtasks automatically. Switching to DSH alone does not uninstall it.
en.runtimeManagedElsewhere: This component is managed by the host or another dependency. Check DSH plugin management; it cannot be removed here.
en.runtimeRestart: Component changed. Restart DSH before using it.
en.runtimeUnavailable: This host has no component management interface. Update DSH or use the manual instructions.
en.searchAutoHint: Codex models use subscription search; other models use DSH
en.searchCodexHint: Search through the signed-in ChatGPT subscription for every model
en.searchDomainsHint: Empty allows all results. Up to 20 comma-separated domains, including subdomains. Filters returned results, not the search service network access.
en.searchDomainsInvalid: Enter up to 20 domains without URL schemes, paths, or wildcards.
en.searchDshHint: Use DSH's current search service for every model
en.searchModeHint: Applies only to Codex subscription search. Cached mode requests indexed results; account support needs live acceptance. Failures do not switch providers.
en.searchScope: Auto follows the current session model; an explicit choice overrides every model and session.
en.sketchAgentHint: Off by default. Use @sketch to ask the Agent to draw; requires the sketch canvas.
en.sketchCanvasHint: Off by default. Enables the manual sketch board.
en.sketchDraftLimit: The 20-draft limit is reached. Export first, or remove an unwanted draft before saving.
en.sketchFailed: Could not attach the sketch. Keep the canvas and try again.
en.sketchFormatHint: PNG is flattened; PSD exchanges pixel layers; editable drafts retain native strokes. Import PSD or draft files up to 32 MB. PSD supports normal pixel layers, fitted to a 1024 px long edge.
en.sketchHiddenLayer: This layer is hidden. Show it or select another layer.
en.sketchHint: Confirming only attaches an image. Describe the style and details before sending.
en.sketchKeyHint: Focus a field and press a key. Duplicate keys are rejected. Ctrl Z / Shift Z undo / redo, Ctrl S save, [ ] brush size.
en.sketchLayerHint: Edit the current layer; export visible layers. Undo includes strokes and layer operations.
en.sketchLimit: Stroke limit reached. Remove unused strokes to continue.
en.sketchLocalDrafts: Saved in this browser, up to 20 drafts. Autosaved on close. Paste or drop PNG / JPEG / WebP images under 20 MB.
en.sketchNavigationHint: Space drag to pan · Alt wheel to zoom · Middle button to pan
en.sketchPicturesEmpty: Import or paste images as layers in this sketch.
en.sketchPsdConfirmBody: Supports simple 8-bit RGB PSDs with up to 8 layers, 32 MB and 4096 pixels per side. Layers become images and the longest side is reduced to 1024 pixels. Masks, adjustments and special blending effects are unsupported. The original file stays unchanged. Use the DSH sketch format to preserve editable sketch objects. Continue?
en.sketchRatioHint: Canvas ratio; artwork fits without distortion, undo available
en.sketchRecoveryFailed: Recovery checkpoint failed. Save or export your draft.
en.sketchRunResumeHint: Allow subsequent drawing requests; does not resend a message
en.sketchShortcuts: B brush · E eraser · L line · R rectangle · O ellipse · [ ] size · Ctrl Z undo · Ctrl Shift Z redo · Ctrl S save · Shift snap line
en.sketchStorageBlocked: Draft storage is in use. Close other sketch windows and retry.
en.sketchStorageFailed: Could not complete the action. Check local storage, draft and layer limits, or image type and size. The canvas is preserved.
en.sketchStorageLimit: Draft storage is full. Export first, or remove an unwanted draft before saving.
en.speedFastAstraHint: About 2x speed on Astra; higher Credits use
en.speedFastHint: Priority processing; speed varies by model; higher Credits use
en.speedUltrafastHint: Ultrafast tier, shown only when your account catalog offers it (Pro 500 today); fastest, uses allowance and Credits faster
en.spendReached: The monthly Credits spending cap has been reached.
en.storageConfirm: This clears local forecast samples for all signed-in accounts. Forecasts will need new samples. Server quotas stay unchanged; subsequent checks recreate the cache.
en.storageFailed: Could not read or clear the forecast cache. Try again.
en.storageHint: Clears local forecast history only. Original images, drafts, sign-in data and shared dependencies are preserved. Manage subtask components under Models & runtime.
en.streamIdleTimeoutHint: How long a request may receive no streamed data before it is aborted. This is not an overall response deadline. Lower values can abort slow but valid reasoning and hand the request to DSH retry handling. Default: 10 minutes.
en.subagentBackendHint: Codex reuses subscription login and workspace permissions, inheriting the current subscription model by default. Turn on model selection under Plugins → Subagent, tick the allowed models and start a new session to request an allowed subscription model and reasoning effort in chat; other model sessions require an explicit selection. Shared-context subtasks stay in DSH.
en.subagentBackendUnavailable: Subagent services are unavailable. Update DSH to use this option.
en.subagentRuntimeCacheHint: Package caches may remain after uninstalling. DSH or Portable manages them centrally. Sign-in, sketches and generated images are not deleted here.
en.subagentRuntimeInstalled: Codex subtask component detected; its executable is checked on startup.
en.subagentRuntimeMissing: Codex subtask runtime is not prepared. Subscription chat does not require it.
en.title: Codex subscription
en.usageEmpty: This account returned no displayable quota windows. Refresh later; this does not mean zero quota.
en.verbosityDefaultHint: Use the official model catalog recommendation

zh.recoveryClearHint: 将移除本插件保存的所有订阅账号登录信息，保留会话和设置。完成后可重新登录。
zh.recoveryFailed: 清除未确认成功，请先恢复 DSH 服务，再重试。
zh.recoveryHint: 重试仍失败时可清除登录信息。连接中断时请先恢复 DSH 服务；高级与诊断可生成本地诊断。
zh.resetAccountChanged: 登录账号已变更，请重新开始。
zh.resetAcknowledge: 我知道这次操作可能立即消耗 1 次重置
zh.resetAcknowledgeRequired: 请先确认已了解这次操作可能消耗重置次数。
zh.resetEarlyWarning: 当前额度未用尽，服务可能不执行重置。
zh.resetExpired: 本次确认已失效，请重新开始。
zh.resetNothing: 当前没有可重置的额度，未消耗新的重置次数。
zh.resetRenewLogin: 登录状态已失效，请重新登录。
zh.resetTooEarly: 请等待冷静期结束后再确认。
zh.resetUncertain: 服务端返回结果不确定。请再次确认，插件会复用同一个请求，不会另外发起一次重置。
zh.resetWarning: 执行后会消耗 1 次，且无法撤销。
zh.runtimeActive: 有 Codex 子任务正在运行，结束后才能安装或卸载。
zh.runtimeBuildBlocked: DSH 拦截了依赖安装脚本。请在官方插件管理中审核后再安装。
zh.runtimeCancelled: 安装已取消，可重新安装。
zh.runtimeConfirm: 卸载后将切回 DSH 子任务。普通订阅聊天、生图、登录和草稿保留。确定卸载可选组件？
zh.runtimeFailed: 操作未完成。请刷新状态后重试；详细原因可在 DSH 插件管理中查看。
zh.runtimeHostUnsupported: 当前 DSH 版本暂无已验证的 Codex 子任务组件。
zh.runtimeIncompatible: 检测到不兼容的 Codex 子任务组件，请卸载后重启，再安装受支持版本。
zh.runtimeInstallHint: 此处只管理官方 Codex 子任务组件，由 DSH 负责安装与卸载。安装后不会自动开启子任务；仅切回 DSH 不会卸载组件。
zh.runtimeManagedElsewhere: 此组件由宿主或其他依赖管理，请在 DSH 插件管理中查看；这里不能直接卸载。
zh.runtimeRestart: 组件已更新，请重启 DSH 后使用。
zh.runtimeUnavailable: 当前宿主未提供组件管理接口，请更新 DSH 或按说明手动管理。
zh.runtime_installing: 正在通过 DSH 安装组件…
zh.runtime_removing: 正在通过 DSH 卸载组件…
zh.searchAutoHint: Codex 模型用订阅搜索，其他模型用 DSH
zh.searchCodexHint: 所有模型通过已登录的 ChatGPT 订阅搜索
zh.searchDomainsHint: 留空显示全部结果；最多 20 个域名，逗号分隔，包含其子域名。只筛选返回结果，不限制搜索服务访问范围。
zh.searchDomainsInvalid: 请输入域名，不含网址协议、路径或通配符。最多 20 个。
zh.searchDshHint: 所有模型使用 DSH 当前搜索服务
zh.searchModeHint: 仅影响 Codex 订阅搜索。缓存模式请求已有索引，需实机确认账户支持；失败时不会自动切换来源。
zh.searchScope: 自动按当前会话模型分流；手动选择会覆盖所有模型和会话。
zh.sketchAgentHint: 默认关闭；开启后可用 @sketch 请求 Agent 绘图，需要同时开启草图画板。
zh.sketchCanvasHint: 默认关闭；开启后显示手动画板入口。
zh.sketchDraftLimit: 已达 20 份草稿上限。请先导出，或删除不需要的草稿后保存。
zh.sketchFailed: 无法附加草图，请保留画板后重试。
zh.sketchFormatHint: PNG 为合并图片；PSD 交换像素图层；可编辑草稿保留原生笔画。可导入 PSD 或草稿文件（32 MB 内）；PSD 仅支持普通像素图层，长边适配至 1024。
zh.sketchHiddenLayer: 当前图层已隐藏，请先显示或选择其他图层。
zh.sketchHint: 确认只会附加图片，不会自动生成。发送时说明你想要的风格与细节。
zh.sketchKeyHint: 点击右侧输入框后按键修改，重复按键不接受。Ctrl Z / Shift Z 撤销重做，Ctrl S 保存；[ ] 调笔宽。
zh.sketchLayerHint: 只编辑当前图层；导出可见图层。撤销支持笔画与图层操作。
zh.sketchLimit: 已达到笔画上限，请清理不需要的笔画后继续。
zh.sketchLocalDrafts: 本浏览器保存，最多 20 份。关闭时自动保存；图片可粘贴或拖入（PNG / JPEG / WebP，20 MB 内）。
zh.sketchNavigationHint: 空格拖动画布 · Alt 滚轮缩放 · 中键拖动
zh.sketchPicturesEmpty: 导入或粘贴图片，作为当前草图的图层。
zh.sketchPsdConfirmBody: 支持最多 8 层、8 位 RGB 的简单 PSD（32 MB 内，边长不超过 4096）。导入后各层转为图片，最长边缩至 1024；不支持蒙版、调整层和特殊混合效果。原文件不会修改。需要保留草图对象的可编辑性，请使用 DSH 草图格式。继续导入？
zh.sketchRatioHint: 画布比例；切换时等比保留笔画，可撤销
zh.sketchRecoveryFailed: 恢复检查点保存失败，请手动保存或导出草稿。
zh.sketchRunResumeHint: 允许 Agent 接收后续绘图请求，不会自动重发消息
zh.sketchShortcuts: B 画笔 · E 橡皮 · L 直线 · R 矩形 · O 椭圆 · [ ] 粗细 · Ctrl Z 撤销 · Ctrl Shift Z 重做 · Ctrl S 保存 · Shift 直线吸附
zh.sketchStorageBlocked: 草稿正被其他窗口占用，请关闭其他草图窗口后重试。
zh.sketchStorageFailed: 未能完成操作。请检查本地存储空间、草稿和图层数量，或图片格式与大小；当前画布仍保留。
zh.sketchStorageLimit: 草稿存储空间已满。请先导出，或删除不需要的草稿后保存。
zh.speedFastAstraHint: Astra 约 2 倍速度，消耗更多 Credits
zh.speedFastHint: 优先处理，速度取决于模型，消耗更多 Credits
zh.speedUltrafastHint: Ultrafast 档，仅账号目录提供时显示（目前为 Pro 500）；速度最快，额度和 Credits 消耗更快
zh.spendReached: Credits 月度消费上限已用尽。
zh.storageConfirm: 清除所有已登录账号的本地预测历史后，需要重新积累采样。服务端额度不变，后续查询会重新生成缓存。
zh.storageFailed: 未能读取或清除预测缓存，请重试。
zh.storageHint: 仅清理本地预测历史，保留原图、草稿、登录信息和共享依赖。子任务组件可在“模型与运行”中管理。
zh.streamIdleTimeoutHint: 连续多久没有收到任何流式数据时中断本次请求，不是整体回答时限。调低可能中断较慢但仍在推理的回答，并交由 DSH 重试处理。默认 10 分钟。
zh.subagentBackendHint: Codex 复用订阅登录和工作区权限；默认继承当前订阅模型。在“插件 → 子智能体”开启模型选择并勾选允许的模型后新建会话，可在聊天中指定允许的订阅模型与推理档位；非订阅会话需指定。共享上下文子任务仍用 DSH。
zh.subagentBackendUnavailable: 当前宿主缺少子代理服务，请更新 DSH。
zh.subagentRuntimeCacheHint: 卸载后安装缓存可能仍保留，由 DSH 或 Portable 统一管理。此处不会删除登录、草稿或生成图片。
zh.subagentRuntimeInstalled: 已检测到 Codex 子任务组件；启动时会检查可执行文件。
zh.subagentRuntimeMissing: 尚未准备 Codex 子任务运行时，仅影响此选项。普通订阅对话无需安装。
zh.title: Codex 订阅
zh.usageEmpty: 当前账户没有返回可显示的额度窗口。请稍后刷新；这不代表额度为零。
zh.verbosityDefaultHint: 使用官方模型目录推荐值
